title: Unital tensor shifts compatible with the specified derived pullback
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], with their derived categories in one localization universe [def-pc-derived-category], their recorded K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and $L=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Equip $L$ with the supplied strong monoidal structure. There exist coherent integer-shift structures on $L$ and on every functor $-\otimes M$ on both ambient derived categories. For these structures, $L$ and every $-\otimes M$ on $D(\mathcal O_Z)$ preserve distinguished triangles. On both schemes the natural transformation $-\otimes b$ commutes with shifts for every morphism $b:M\to N$. For every $M\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ the inverse tensorator $L(K\otimes M)\to L(K)\otimes L(M)$, natural in $K$, commutes with the composite shifts. The right-unitor natural transformation $-\otimes\mathcal O_Y\to\mathrm{id}$ commutes with shifts. No direct image, adjunction, projection isomorphism, map to the unit, or specified comparison transformation is part of this statement.

source.place: Proof, exactness of the composite tensor and pullback functors; expanded for the simultaneous unital shifts required by Tags 0A9U and 0A9S (equation-compare-with-pullback).

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-derived-monoidal-pullback-unital-shift-kflat-one to obtain simultaneous coherent shifts, pullback and target-tensor exactness, and four compatibility squares at translation by one on K-flat representatives.

For every derived object K, choose a K-flat resolution P of Q.objPreimage K using lem-pc-kflat-resolution. Localization inverts its quasi-isomorphism, giving Q(P) isomorphic to K. For each of the four natural transformations, its two shift-square paths are natural transformations. Naturality along this isomorphism and cancellation of its invertible shifted image transport the square from Q(P) to K.

For arbitrary coherent integer shifts, prove a cancellation lemma: compatibility for b and a+b implies compatibility for a. Expand the addition comparisons, use their naturality, cancel the invertible comparison maps, and use faithfulness of shift by b. Compatibility for zero is automatic, so the square at one gives the square at minus one. Int.induction_on and NatTrans.CommShiftCore.add give every integer. Apply this argument to the tensor-morphism transformations on Y and Z, the inverse tensorator, and the right unitor, and assemble the original conjunction.

proof_origin.place: G1: representative construction isolated; naturality along K-flat replacement isomorphisms and integer-shift cancellation formalized. The existing representative-construction route and unit route are unchanged.
